Digital Realty publishes individual building pages with real street addresses for most named buildings in this campus (for example IAD37 at 44060 Digital Loudoun Plaza Bldg K, IAD36 at 43780 Digital Loudoun Plaza Bldg H, IAD40 at 44372 Round Table Plaza Bldg M, VA4 at 8217 Linton Hall Road in Bristow, VA3 at 1780 Business Center Drive in Reston), confirmed via digitalrealty.com and third-party colocation marketplaces (UPSTACK, datacenterHawk).

reading.body:
The Lafayette Center Drive Campus is a Digital Realty facility in Fairfax County, Virginia, part of the Northern Virginia data center concentration that includes at least six named buildings across multiple counties. The operator has not published critical IT capacity for this specific campus, so its power consumption and rack density cannot be assessed from disclosed specifications.

Virginia has 326 mapped data center facilities, of which 23 publish power capacity totaling 1,375 MW. This campus does not appear in the ranked 23, meaning its published capacity, if any, falls below the disclosure threshold or has not been reported to this research site.

Without published power or IT load figures, this campus cannot be positioned within Virginia's AI infrastructure or ranked against other sites competing for grid access. The existence of the facility confirms Digital Realty's physical footprint in Data Center Alley, but its relevance to AI scaling decisions depends on capacity data the operator has not made public.
